vb_textbox.text: To start if the colour you choose is above 4 then stick with it until it drops down to 4 and stays low on the next click. If that happens then switch colour. If high then stick with it, if  this is also low then alternate between the colours until one becomes high then stick with that. It seems to go through phases where they are both low. However within a few click one will shoot up to 7 or higher. The highest it seemed to go for me was 9 and the lowest was 0. (I have a feeling it's random and the experimenters are just trying to see if you will create some elaborate system to figure out the best course of action)The above system seemed to work for me and I managed to get 1400 points. Not sure yet if that's good or bad as they haven't told me how much i've earned. Best of luck to you and Peace be the Journey (Cool Runnings quote for you there)
